name: Black Ice Abyssal
promptTemplate: Looking down into {{depth_tint}} black ice with {{snap_style}} cracks, bubble density at {{bubble_density}} and crack energy at {{crack_energy}} with frost bloom {{bloom_frost}}.

crack_energy.hint: Crank up fracture frequency and spread

bubble_density.hint: Adjust count of frozen methane columns

listing.blurb: Fracture lines race across deep black lake ice, revealing stacked columns of frozen methane bubbles trapped in the glow.
listing.prompt: Looking down through black ice on a frozen lake: white fracture lines race across it with a snap, trapped methane bubbles stacked in frozen columns beneath, frost blooming at the edges. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
